title: There Are no Such Things as Constitutional Rights - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
Note: This is an article that I published on April 19th, 2020, over 6 years ago, at the onset of the criminal and fake ‘covid’ scam. I constantly here the phrase “Constitutional Rights,“ and heard this uttered once again this morning by a supposed man of freedom. This term always is upsetting to hear, but then, it is simply worthless propaganda drilled into Americans from birth, which in essence, plants the seed that government is the giver or definer of rights, which is ludicrous on its face. I thought it was appropriate to republish this article in order to clarify the notion of rights, and to destroy any idea that rights come from any man or government. They do not. Rights are natural and inherent, period!
“A man’s natural rights are his own, against the whole world; and any infringement of them is equally a crime, whether committed by one man, or by millions; whether committed by one man, calling himself a robber, (or by any other name indicating his true character,) or by millions, calling themselves a government.”
Read Full Article: https://www.lewrockwell.com/2026/08/gary-d-barnett/there-are-no-such-things-as-constitutional-rights/
